heading: Sunday
text: A few morning clouds through the St. Lawrence and Champlain Valley, into the Adirondacks, then mostly sunny. Not as windy and cold. Highs in the upper 40s to mid 50s. Light winds east of the Green Mountains, turning to the south in the afternoon from the Green Mountains west near 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph near Lake Champlain.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly clear and not as cold. Lows in the 20s to near 30 northeast, in the 30s west and south. Light winds east of the Green Mountains, and south winds from the Green Mountains west 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly sunny, with some high clouds edging into southern areas during the afternoon. Milder. Highs in the 50s to low 60s. Light winds east of the Green Mountains, and south winds from the Green Mountains west 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.
